title: React Counter
description: Build an interactive counter with React using components and state

steps.title: Create a Component
steps.description: Create a React functional component called Counter that renders a <div> with a heading 'Counter' inside it. Use ReactDOM.createRoot to render it to document.getElementById('root').
hints: Components are JavaScript functions that return JSX.

verification.failureMessage: Make sure your component renders an <h1> with 'Counter'

steps.title: Add State
steps.description: Import the useState hook and add a count state variable initialized to 0. Display the count in a <p> tag.

verification.failureMessage: Make sure you display 'Count: 0' using the count state

steps.title: Add Buttons
steps.description: Add two buttons: one labeled '+' that increments the count, and one labeled '-' that decrements the count. Use the onClick event handler.

verification.failureMessage: Add both + and - buttons inside the component

steps.title: Prevent Negative
steps.description: Add a validation: the count should never go below 0. When the '-' button is clicked, only decrement if count is greater than 0.
hints: Use an if statement or ternary inside the onClick: count > 0 && setCount(count - 1)

verification.successMessage: Counter is safe from going negative!
verification.failureMessage: Add a guard to prevent count from going below 0
